note: The paper's render as data (F101, 2026-10-22): every tool run that produces a figure, table or number the paper prints, in the order scripts/render_paper_figures.py runs them. Paths are relative to the repository root. `driving` is the CARLA figure tool over the roster pools (the first campaigns' agents, the three-seed gauntlet pool, and the three warehouse pools of the stock brain, which the per-agent tables and the numbers document summarize beside the driving agents) with the extension pools (PlanT 2.0 v06, SimLingo v07, HiP-AD v08, TFv6 RegNetY v09, the two warehouse fine-tunes v07), writing the figures, the tables, the sensitivity table and the numbers document TN. `warehouse` is the Isaac figure tool: the stock brain from campaign v08, the two fine-tunes from v07, and the stock-versus-fine-tune pair on the composed stacks. `profiles` are the paper's profile figures (P-*, CS, PW, PV) in the paper's design, into profiles/<design>/{carla,isaac}; one design per render, so every figure file name occurs once under the output and the paper checker finds each by name. `atlas` is the scenario family figure from the raw bundles' recordings. Which pools, which brains, which figure ids and which design are the paper's choices and live here, never in code.
